items.layers: L0 trace birth, L1 trace/copy/write modes, L2 mode-aware tutor scaffold, L3 support tiers, L4 scoped structural difficulty. Next skill: /add-sound after the device review.
items.built: Trace, copy beside a separate model, and write from an audible letter name over 52 code-owned uppercase/lowercase references. Stroke capture keeps every attempt and retry. Copy/write feedback is provisional and local-only. Mode-aware tutor scaffold (15 context keys, three hint levels, six struggle responses). Support tiers withdraw numbered starts, arrows, line labels and reminders per challenge. Structural difficulty selects low/middle/high form complexity within the allowed case, widening the band so every challenge gets a distinct letter.
items.verified: All three modes and the easy/medium/hard trace sweep pass the /api/lumina/eval-test harness. Nine headless browser mode/tier flows over 36 challenges pass drawing, check, retry, next, finish and evidence submission. 13 post-fix live draws gave 4/4 distinct letters at every tier. typecheck:lumina 0; 252/252 focused tests. Browser speech completion was simulated, not heard.
items.owed: Human review of all 52 manuscript forms and stroke conventions. Audible cues on real devices. Child finger and stylus tolerances. Calibrate copy/write feedback and verify backend evidence replay before adaptive updates. Full live tutor coaching. Mode priors (trace 1.5, copy 3.5, write 5.0) are design values, not empirical calibration.
items.open: /lumina -> Developer Tools -> Language Arts -> Writing -> Letter Workshop -> Generate Content (topics: Trace lowercase l; Letter Formation Group 2). Pick a mode and a Letter difficulty.

items.layers: L0 spoken birth, L1 describe_action / describe_independent_action, L2 tutor context, L3 support tiers; structural difficulty assessed and kept support-only under the two-mode contract; sound audited as runner-owned.
items.built: Spoken I/you perspective sentences across three paired scenes (six turns). describe_action asks for I or you from the current speaking role; describe_independent_action binds myself/yourself to the same actor. Voice-judged through the shared useJudgedScriptRunner with a scripted opener, scene replay and capped corrections. Support tiers withdraw the speaker highlight, actor marker and role checklist while names, roles, replay and correction stay at every tier.
items.verified: Nine eval-test generations (58 turns) across both modes at easy, medium and hard plus mixed and blended sessions. Three tier-aware tutor prompt probes with zero audit findings. 48 focused tests; typecheck:lumina 0. Sound: existing runner sounds traced, no edits needed.
items.owed: Real browser and microphone acceptance: role switches, a fluent wrong-perspective sentence, a bare pronoun, an echoed named scene and a valid paraphrase. Listen for sound levels, overlap with tutor speech and spurious microphone turns. Rehearsal is not proof of conversational transfer.

items.layers: L0 birth + L2 tutored (judged-loop strong form at birth). No eval-mode ladder yet: /add-eval-modes owns match_setting, say_alike and say_different; then support tiers, structural difficulty (similarity depth), sound and affordances tags.
items.built: Core task match_character: the Live tutor reads two stories, names an anchor character, and the child taps the far-shore character who acted alike; a bridge draws between the shores on affirm. Gesture items run through the shared useJudgedScriptRunner, which owns the clock. Story text is audio-only before the verdict; the two evidence sentences print on affirm; the anchor shore is never tappable and the far shore is reshuffled per item. The explicit fallback pair discloses itself. Catalog tutoring block present at birth.
items.verified: Five eval-test generations (three challenges each, no fallback) pass the G1/G2/G4/G5 checks; two answer-leak classes were caught and gated at birth (a title naming a character; describing-word names). Headless DI drive PASS; script tests 14/14; DI-script suites 1636/1636; typecheck:lumina 0.
items.owed: Human browser and microphone sitting on a tablet with a real tap: stage shuffle, reveal and hear-again. The eval-mode ladder (match_setting, say_alike, say_different), support tiers, structural difficulty, sound and affordances tags. Six of the seven mapped requirements have no task yet; only LA006-04-B is addressed by the birth mode.

items.layers: L0 spoken birth, L1 five eval modes, L2 mode-aware tutor scaffold, L3 support tiers, L4 narrative-shape difficulty, L5 procedural sound.
items.built: Children rearrange three pictorial event cues and tell one connected account. Five modes separate tense-open retelling, present/future/past storytelling, and a privacy-safe story-to-experience connection. The judged runner owns prompting, feedback, retry and progression; picture labels stay time-neutral and model sentences remain hidden until a verdict.
items.verified: Post-fix generation aligned 27/27 visible cues with judged event meanings. Ten pinned eval-mode runs plus blended and five-mode mixed sessions passed; 20/20 baseline/tier generations, 1,000 offline structural constructions, 30/30 focused tests, two backend calibration tests, tutor prompt probes, and Lumina typecheck all passed.
items.owed: Human tablet/browser and microphone acceptance: card swapping, responsive layout, reveal and hear-again timing, fluent correct and wrong-tense responses, privacy-safe decline handling, real-child speech capture, and sound levels. Adaptive mastery credit remains gated on that sitting.
